name: Password Sign-In Rejected
summary: A user enters through Welcome, chooses email authentication, submits password credentials that are not accepted, and receives a non-enumerating rejected sign-in experience without establishing a session.
finalOutcome: No authenticated session is established and the user receives the same rejected sign-in experience whether the internal cause is invalid credentials or an unknown account.

sourceReferences.note: Unknown account and invalid password now share the same public AUTH001 rejection while retaining distinct internal auth-log events.
Integration coverage separately proves user-not-found and invalid-credential audit trails.
Canonical rejected surface is implemented on web; mobile remains planned.
Server implementation is reconciled, but behavior implementation remains needs-review until the rejected outcome surface is implemented on mobile.
